Subject: Collaborative evaluation blueprint — quick MAP seed

Hi Ravi —

Great to meet on Friday. Per our call, I’m attaching a lightweight MAP template that we use for 30–45 day technical pilots aimed at fast decision cycles (we call this one 'Close in 45'). The doc is deliberately short: objectives, success metrics, stakeholders + roles, week-by-week validation checkpoints, and a simple risk register.

What I’m hoping for from your side:
- Confirm the core success metric (one KPI you want validated in the 45-day window)
- Share the 3 technical owners we should loop in for a short kickoff
- Any compliance or data-residency constraints we should bake into the pilot plan

I’ve also dropped a starter slide deck with suggested demo agenda + acceptance criteria. If you’re open, I can seed the MAP doc with what we discussed and circulate a version for your edits this week.

Attachments: MAP_Template_collab_v1.docx (docx), Close-in-45_playbook_v0.pdf (pdf), CloseIn45_gslides_stub.pptx (pptx)

Thanks — happy to slot a 30-minute sync if easier.

— Alex

Alex — thanks for the template and slides. Quick answers:
- Primary KPI: end-to-end clinical document classification accuracy (label-level F1 on the production-ish sample) — target > 0.88
- Tech owners: myself (product), Emma Li (ML lead), and our infra lead (I’ll loop in separately)
- Data constraints: PHI is sensitive; we need to ensure logs are stored in our HIPAA-controlled S3 bucket and that any debug exports are scrubbed.

A couple questions:
1) How do you usually handle model fallbacks if the pilot hits latency spikes?
2) Can we get an option in the MAP to extend the pilot by two weeks if our initial validation needs more examples?

If you can pre-seed the MAP with the KPI and owners we’ll take a pass and return edits. Also cc’ing Emma so she sees the technical notes.

Best,
Ravi

Ravi / Emma — thanks, that helps a lot. I’ve seeded the MAP doc with the KPI (F1 target >0.88) and the three owners you named. High-level responses to your questions below.

On model fallbacks: we recommend a two-tier approach in the pilot MAP:
- Primary: the tuned open model variant we’ll serve for the main validation path (we optimize for quality/latency tradeoff up front)
- Fallback: a smaller quantized variant with consistent latency that we can route to automatically if p95 latency crosses the pilot threshold for 3 consecutive minutes. Routing rules live in the MAP under 'operational fallbacks' so your infra team can validate them.

On pilot extension: absolutely — we include a built-in 'extension trigger' clause (section: timeline + gating). If the validation window shows data drift or annotation backlog > 20% we automatically propose a 14-day extension for fuller coverage.

I attached an updated one-page 'Close in 45' playbook (pdf) and added the Google Doc + Slides links below — please use the Doc for edits so we keep a single source of truth. Marissa will coordinate the kickoff and Jonas will be the engineering contact for any pre-demo infra checks. Naomi will help curate the acceptance test set.

Google Doc (MAP draft): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2B3cCloseIn45Draft
Google Slides (demo + acceptance): https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1xYzCloseIn45Slides
